subject: Alicia's Law (La Ley de Alicia)
query: is alicia's law based on the good wife
title: Is Alicia's Law based on The Good Wife? Yes, it's the Mexican remake
answer: Yes. "Alicia's Law" ("La Ley de Alicia") is a Mexican Netflix adaptation of the American legal drama "The Good Wife," which aired on CBS from 2009 to 2016. Fernanda Castillo stars as Alicia. Part 1 premieres on Netflix on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, and Part 2 arrives Dec. 9, 2026.
body:
In the Netflix version, Alicia's life falls apart when her husband, Aurelio (Juan Manuel Bernal), a Supreme Court justice, is brought down by a public scandal. She returns to practicing law to support her two children and reconnects with David (Michel Brown), her college sweetheart, who now owns the firm where she works. The series is produced by CBS Studios with TIS Estudios and is set against Mexico's political landscape.

The original "The Good Wife" ran seven seasons on CBS with Julianna Margulies in the lead role and won five Primetime Emmys from 43 nominations. Neither the original nor the Mexican remake is presented as a true story; both are fictional legal dramas.
in_the_news: Part 1 of "Alicia's Law" premieres on Netflix on Nov. 11, 2026.

faq.q: When does Alicia's Law come out?
faq.a: Part 1 premieres Nov. 11, 2026, and Part 2 on Dec. 9, 2026, on Netflix.

faq.q: Who is in the cast of Alicia's Law?
faq.a: Fernanda Castillo (Alicia), Juan Manuel Bernal (Aurelio) and Michel Brown (David), with Claudio Roca, Alaíde and Caro Darman among the supporting cast.

faq.q: Is Alicia's Law a true story?
faq.a: No. It is a fictional drama adapted from the CBS series "The Good Wife."

faq.q: What is La Ley de Alicia in English?
faq.a: "Alicia's Law," the English title Netflix uses for the series.
